cases.expectedObservation: Pause provenance, mutate caller containers/cache and verify original artifact/selection through submission and decoding.
Valid provenance for another artifact with identical SQL text cannot authorize original execution.
Independently distinguish zero submissions, confirmed post-command publication refusal and unresolved native termination.
Registration change cannot substitute original decoder/obligation meanings or reinterpret admitted rows.
Original artifact/decoder custody cannot preserve revoked authority or stale catalog/context admission.
Capture resource failure, malformed later rows and unresolved obligations yield no partial executed result or automatic retry.

replacementMechanism: optional; explicit unavailable if not selected, never a passed race receipt
coverageRule: CE cases supplement Truss host execution planning. Primary US-030 coverage and Weft compiler conformance remain separate; no passing support claim follows inventory presence.
